mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 5.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline and risk assets become relatively more attractive.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% in the prior three months signals persistent labor market slack, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as recessionary expectations intensify and risk-off sentiment dominates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above 12-month averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed 12-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) rising above 100 in early-cycle expansion regimes signals improving manufacturing output, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as supply chain efficiency boosts profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during early-cycle expansion when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 315.0 in the prior month indicates accelerating inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as central bank tightening expectations increase and real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when CPIAUCSL exceeds 315.0.

mechanism_narrative: Real sales (RSAFS) above 12-month average consistently produces positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as strong consumer spending supports corporate revenue growth and margin expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth below 100,000 (PAYEMS < 100,000) signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as recession risks increase and fiscal stimulus expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when PAYEMS falls below 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) above 12-month averages indicate broad economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as output growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST exceed 12-month averages.
